quote: In contrast to normal-gravity tests, the microgravity flames exhibit a distinct peak ion current that corresponds to the most compact flame
subject: In microgravity the ion current peaks at the most compact flame, unlike in normal gravity

quote: Soot generation could be suppressed and more broadly there are clear correlations between the flame luminosity, combustion intensity, and ion current in the ISS data.
subject: An electric field can suppress soot; luminosity, combustion intensity and ion current go together

quote: It was found that highly diluted flames can be stabilized with very weak electric fields.
subject: Very weak electric fields can stabilise highly diluted flames

quote: But at high field strengths, the flames exhibited corona and arc discharges.
subject: At high field strengths flames showed corona and arc discharges

quote: When ACME’s ISS testing ended in Feb. 2022, over 1,500 flames were ignited for its six experiments.
subject: Scope: over 1,500 flames were lit for the six ACME experiments, November 2017 to February 2022
